regions.region: page 1 title, authors, metadata, abstract, and graphical abstract
regions.finding: Verified the article title and current racemic-allene/TMSCN/NFSI-to-chiral-allenyl-nitrile reaction class. The graphical abstract is an aggregate summary and is linked to the current general scheme rather than treated as a separate experiment.

regions.region: page 1 two-column Introduction
regions.finding: Classified the cited radical allene-synthesis approaches as prior literature/context. External cited experiments were not imported as current-paper runs.

unresolved: The graphical abstract/current class contains generic colored substituents rather than experiment-specific structures and charges.
No workspace SI association is established.

regions.region: page 2 upper Scheme 1a natural-product structures
regions.finding: Inspected four illustrative natural products. They are molecular context without reaction arrows or current-paper preparations, so no experiment records were fabricated.

regions.region: page 2 upper Scheme 1b prior pathway map
regions.finding: Separated three cited prior routes: enyne/alkyne radical allene synthesis, propargylic C(sp3)-H cyanation, and pre-existing-allene C(sp2)-H functionalization. The generic arrows remain literature examples, not present-paper experiments.

regions.region: page 2 upper Scheme 1c current generic arrow
regions.finding: Recorded one general current-work transformation with the printed 35-example/up-to-97:3-er/up-to-10-mmol summary; concrete runs are separate records.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right optimization narrative
regions.finding: Mapped the model substrate, NFSI/TMSCN, Cu/ligand/additive screening, temperatures/times, and optimal CuBr2/L7/A4 condition to the thirteen Table 1 rows on page 3 without creating narrative duplicates.

unresolved: Scheme 1 generic/prior structures do not define experiment-specific charges or yields.
The optimization narrative refers details to unassociated SI; no SI-only rows were inferred.

regions.region: page 3 upper Table 1 reaction header and structures
regions.finding: Read the shared 1a 0.1 mmol, NFSI 0.15 mmol/1.5 equiv, TMSCN 0.3 mmol/3 equiv, Cu 5 mol%, ligand 7.5 mol%, optional additive 1 mol%, acetone 0.1 M, N2, room-temperature/24 h condition and L1-L7/A1-A4 drawings.

regions.region: page 3 Table 1 entries 1-13 and footnotes a-e
regions.finding: Recorded all thirteen rows independently. Footnote d changes rows 8-13 to 0 °C/48 h; footnote e changes entry 13 to CuBr2. Isolated yields and HPLC er values remain product-targeted.

regions.region: page 3 lower substrate-scope and transformations prose
regions.finding: Linked the 35 Scheme 2 products, three 10 mmol scale-ups, and described 3a downstream transformations to their page-4/5 arrows without duplicating experiments. The text supplies explicit absence of C(sp3)-H cyanation for 3u/3v/3w and X-ray assignment of 3c.

unresolved: Table 1 omits solvent volumes, workups, purifications, and product masses.
Scheme 2 yield/er analytical bases and individual workups are not reported on covered pages.

regions.region: page 4 full Scheme 2 reaction header and product grid
regions.finding: Recorded every depicted 3a-3y and 5a-5j arrow as a separate 0.2 mmol scope experiment with printed yield/er. The red parenthetical 3a/3y/5c outcomes are separate 10 mmol scale-up experiments. CCDC 2423438 is linked to 3c characterization.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left continuation of further-transformations prose
regions.finding: Linked NBS cyclization of 7, CuBr2 cyclization of 8, and cyclizations of acid 9 to the corresponding Scheme 3 arrows on page 5; no prose duplicates were created.

regions.region: page 4 lower-right start of Mechanistic Investigations
regions.finding: The text states that separate TEMPO and BHT standard-condition controls completely suppressed product formation; both are represented as distinct controls in Scheme 4a.

unresolved: Scheme 2 and Scheme 3 omit absolute scaled charges, workups, purifications, masses, and analytical bases.
The mechanistic-control absolute scale is not restated.

regions.region: page 5 upper Scheme 3 eight reaction arrows
regions.finding: Recorded eight distinct transformations: 3a→6, 6→7, 7→10, 3a→8, 8→11, 3a→9, 9→12, and 9→13. Every printed equivalent/loading/concentration, temperature, time, atmosphere, yield and er is structured on its own arrow.

regions.region: page 5 lower-left mechanistic-investigation prose
regions.finding: Linked radical scavenging, radical clock, KIE, NLE, L8 control, and complex-16 catalyst test to their Scheme 4 panels on page 6. The standard L7 comparator is merged with Table 1 entry 13.

regions.region: page 5 lower/right Scheme 5 discussion, conclusions, and materials statement
regions.finding: Classified A-C and radical species as a proposed catalytic cycle, not preparations. Conclusions add no experiment. The statement that procedures are in SI does not establish a workspace SI association.

unresolved: Scheme 3 does not report absolute scale, workup, purification, masses, or yield/er analytical bases.
NLE operating details and data coordinates are not printed on covered pages.

regions.region: page 6 Scheme 4a radical trapping
regions.finding: Recorded TEMPO and BHT as separate 3-equivalent standard-condition controls; desired 3a was not observed in either.

regions.region: page 6 Scheme 4b-c radical clock and KIE
regions.finding: Recorded the 14→15 ring-opening experiment (14%, 64:36 er) and one 4a/4a-d KIE comparison series with kH/kD=2.3. Separate isotopologue yields were not invented.

regions.region: page 6 Scheme 4d nonlinear-effect graph
regions.finding: Recorded the varied-L7-ee series, printed R²=0.9951, linear observation, and monoligand interpretation. Unprinted graph coordinates and operating details were not estimated.

regions.region: page 6 Scheme 4e-f ligand/complex controls
regions.finding: Recorded the distinct L8 control (50%, 93:7 er) and L7CuBr2 crystal-catalyst test (47%, 92:8 er). The standard-L7 58%/93:7 comparator is merged into Table 1 entry 13. CCDC 2425802 is characterization provenance for 16.

regions.region: page 6 Scheme 5 proposed mechanism
regions.finding: Recorded one ordered proposed cycle (SET, HAT, transmetalation, asymmetric group transfer); A-C and radicals remain mechanism entities rather than reported preparations.

regions.region: page 6 Associated Content and author information
regions.finding: The publisher advertises experimental procedures/spectra/CIF files in online SI, but source mapping marks association unestablished. No SI fact was imported; author information is administrative only.

unresolved: Mechanistic panels omit several absolute scales, workups, purifications, product masses, analytical bases, detection limits, and NLE graph-point tables.
The online Supporting Information statement does not establish a workspace SI association.
